services.name: Event and Facility Rentals
services.desc: Our 19th century Heritage Village is surrounded by 46 acres of beautiful gardens, fields, and forests. History comes alive at Fanshawe Pioneer Village to help make your event, whether personal or professions, a complete success. With a variety of space accommodating 15 - 150 guests, the Village has the perfect space for your gathering! You can rent one of our venues to create your own party, join us for a special Village event, or schedule private activities inside the Heritage Village for your group or family to enjoy.
